text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
"Well then, that's the end of math remedial lessons!
Make sure to get a good score on the next pop quiz!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, what a drag... Finally done...
My shoulders are completely stiff though...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Gotta get home and rest.
Aaargh, I'm so sleepy...

text_block_list.name: Teacher B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Jordan-san! Chemistry supplementary class after this!
You're definitely attending today.

text_block_list.name: Teacher C
text_block_list.text:
Wait, you need help with Classical Japanese too...? Good grief.
Make sure you come over right after your chemistry makeup class!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Haaah!? Wait, Teach,
you're just assigning remedial lessons on a whim, aren't you!? Seriously!

text_block_list.name: Teachers
text_block_list.text: I'm deciding based on test scores!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though entirely a result of her own making,
Tosen Jordan was left thoroughly dispirited
by one makeup lesson after another...
